Overview.Name: Venkata Gopalarao Mandada
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Preference_Notes: Results first – include non-veg as needed for best results

Meal_1: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (150 g) & vegetable curry + curd (small bowl)
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & fish curry (150 g) & vegetable curry + curd (small bowl)
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & egg curry (2–3 eggs) & vegetable curry
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & chicken curry (120 g) + any 1 fruit (apple, banana, orange or papaya)
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & egg omelette (2 eggs) + vegetable curry + any 1 fruit
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & paneer cubes (80 g) & vegetable curry + any 1 fruit

Notes_and_Tips: Start meals with chicken, eggs or paneer before eating rice to improve portion control.
Keep meals simple to reduce stress and improve consistency.
Walking daily will support both mental wellbeing and fat loss.
Maintain consistent meal timing for better energy and mood balance.
